notes: Six pages, one Common Crawl snapshot each; all readable. (1) UBC Sauder alumni pages for 2001, 2003 and 2014 are tables Name | Current University | Division/Specialization under a "UBC PhD Alumni <year>" heading; the year is the alumni-list year (the 2014 page intro says the program has been "graduating" students since 1972, and the year index runs 1972-2014), but the page never states that the year is the graduation year, so yearMeaning is "unstated"; the integrator may treat it as graduation. The "Current University" column is the affiliation as of the page (last updated 9/20/2017), so it is recorded as destination with a note and must not be read as a first placement. Email addresses printed next to several names on the 2001 and 2003 pages were deliberately omitted (personal contact details). Division codes (MKT, FIN, OB, SC, MIS, TRANS/ POL, POL, ACC, SBE) are copied as written; "SC" presumably denotes the management science / operations & logistics stream but the page does not expand it. (2) The UBC "Research on Slacktivism" page is a single alumni story about Kirk Kristofferson (no graduation year; Assistant Professor at Arizona State University; advisors Katherine White and Darren Dahl). Its "Related Stories" sidebar links to "LEAH SHEPPARD PhD challenges gender bias in the workplace"; no row was written for that link because it carries no data beyond the name (she is recorded from the 2014 alumni page). (3) UCI Merage "Dissertations" page lists 68 names with dissertation titles grouped by area (Accounting 7, Economics/Public Policy 2, Finance 6, Information Systems 12, Marketing 21, Operations & Decision Technologies 6, Organization & Management 6, Organization & Strategy 6, Strategy 2) with no years and no placements; degree recorded as PhD from the page section, listedYear null. Several titles contain the page's own typos ("Technlogy", "Emperical", "Stratagy", "Firm-Spacific") and were kept verbatim. "Zatzick Christopher Douglas" is copied as written and is probably surname-first. (4) UCLA Anderson "2017-2018 Job Market Candidates": 12 candidates with area, dissertation title, job market paper title and advisors; listedYear 2018 with the 2017-2018 range in note; several titles are "TBA"/"N/A" as written. The page's "Ph.D. Students" sidebar (current students by area) was skipped except where a person is also a listed candidate. No row in this chunk gives a first placement.
